findings.evidence: Lines 195–345 place all these declarations under `(P : SpinPolarizationData Q)`, while lines 412–452 prove for arbitrary `hQ` that the center has rank two and exhibit `span F {1, ω} ≤ center` with that span also of rank two. Equality follows by equal finite dimensions, so the same witness supplies the general span/adjoin and downstream results.
findings.fix: State the canonical results under `hQ : Q.Nondegenerate` and odd finrank, using the general rank theorem plus the central, nonzero odd volume element: its two-dimensional span lies in the two-dimensional center, hence equals it; derive the even-scalar and noncentrality conclusions from this and remove the duplicated polarized special cases.
